title: A Measured Route
premise: Aren returns for the controlled-transfer assessment he missed. Passing matters only if he can use the recognized competence in someone else’s working route without abandoning his own morning.
reading_premise: One bell for an assessment. One short paid carry afterward. Aren needs to learn whether the control he has practiced is useful to people who have their own work to finish.
